prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose How to Adopt Your Desktop Companion", "Pick a classic pet companion instantly or generate a unique desktop pet from photos.", "Select Path"]
1: ["Play While Your Pet Prepares!", "Practice feeding and playing with your digital pet companion preview."]
2: ["Customize Pet Appearance & Traits", "Fine-tune colors and personality traits before creating your certificate."]
3: []
4: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original account to keep your existing desktop pet!", "Account Sync Active"]
5: ["We are preparing your desktop pet overlay. This usually takes under 2 minutes."]
6: ["Tip: Right-click your pet to open controls, or drag to reposition anywhere on your desktop!", "Controls Guide"]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Confirm & Finalize Adoption", "Official Companion"]
8: ["Your pet is now active on your desktop!"]
9: ["Ready to Meet Your Desktop Pet?", "Pick a ready-to-play companion in seconds, or upload photos to build a unique custom pet."]
